reporting-org.narrative: Women's international league for peace and freedom

title.narrative: Enhanced spaces for Yemeni women to lead an inclusive and sustainable feminist peace process

description.narrative: The overall aim of this project is to achieve a grassroot centered, inclusive and sustainable agenda to the peace negotiations and transition in Yemen through enhancing feminist spaces for Yemeni women.

title.narrative: Enhanced feminist space for strategic collaboration, trust building and exchange of information between different women inclusion platforms.
1.C Level of satisfaction of women with the convening (and other spaces created) as safe spaces for strategic collaboration

comment.narrative: 5 day High Level Convening towards feminist peace in Yemen, celebrating and exchanging on the efforts of Yemeni women leaders of diverse backgrounds to support the peace process: 75% of participants felt Convening offered a safe space for collaboration.
Third high level Yemen Feminist Peace Convening - 22 speakers, alongside 90 attendees. No convening survey but quotes from participants can be found in the narrative report.

title.narrative: 1.B Evidence of collaboration between women inside and outside Yemen

actual.value: Evidence: PTI has supported the collaboration of women inside and ooutside Yemen through the Feminist Core Group and the Women Solidarity Network, which resulted in increased participation of women in official positions such as in the National Reconciliation and Consultation Commission, and the appointment of two new women judges
